text: Alright, thanks for coming with me on this trip. I'll understand if you have to take a break at any point.
You've learned to hike. There's no way left to go but up.
Starting over is harder than starting up. Feel free to go away and come back. I'll be here.
You could have refused, but you didn't. There was something in you that was hidden, that chose to continue.
Imaginary mountains build themselves from our efforts to climb them, and it's our repeated attempts to reach the summit that turns those mountains into something real.
In a moment I'll shut up, but let me say: I'm glad you came. I dedicate this game to you, the one who came this far.
Your candle is running low. Keep an eye out for wax, and keep going—one ledge at a time.
